resources.string: Explore 999 objects, all 88 constellations and public LV-426, with refined tracking and scientific references.
New graphics pack 1.6: 174 images and 174 separate previews, downloaded individually and cached offline.
Clearer Info, refined capture and panorama icons, and higher-contrast Observatory and Daily path shortcuts at night.
Types ordered by object count, alphabetical sorting options and clearer object controls.
Steadier reference labels and Nadir at −90°, opposite Zenith.
Improved moon motion, selected-object close approaches and explicit weather-loading status.
